' AUTO DESIGN 3D macro for SOLIDWORKS 2018
' Tools > Macro > Run, choose this .swb file (or paste it into a new macro).
' It builds the part, then saves Mounting_Bracket.SLDPRT next to this macro.
Option Explicit
Dim swApp As Object
Dim Part As Object
Dim fm As Object
Dim sm As Object
Dim Planes(2) As Object
Dim Problems As String

Sub main()
    Dim tpl As String, folder As String, target As String
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    tpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)
    If tpl = "" Then tpl = swApp.GetDocumentTemplate(1, "", 0, 0, 0)
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument(tpl, 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Cannot create a new part. Set the default part template in System Options."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set fm = Part.FeatureManager
    Set sm = Part.SketchManager
    If Not FindPlanes() Then
        MsgBox "Front, Top and Right planes were not found in the template."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Step1
    Step2
    Step3
    Step4
    Step5
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    folder = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder
    target = folder & "\Mounting_Bracket.SLDPRT"
    Part.SaveAs3 target, 0, 1
    If Problems = "" Then
        MsgBox "Done. All features match the STEP model." & vbCrLf & target
    Else
        MsgBox "Saved, but check these features:" & vbCrLf & Problems & vbCrLf & target
    End If
End Sub

Sub Step1()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.0)
    sm.CreateLine -0.05, -0.04, 0, 0.05, -0.04, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.05, -0.04, 0, 0.05, 0.04, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.05, 0.04, 0, -0.05, 0.04, 0
    sm.CreateLine -0.05, 0.04, 0, -0.05, -0.04, 0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Base plate", nm, False, True, 0, 0, 0.006, 0.0, 0, 0.0, False, 48000.0, -0.0, 3.0, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step2()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(0, 0.034)
    sm.CreateLine -0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.05, 0.0, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.05, 0.06, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.05, 0.06, 0, -0.05, 0.06, 0
    sm.CreateLine -0.05, 0.06, 0, -0.05, 0.0, 0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Upright", nm, False, True, 0, 0, 0.006, 0.0, 0, 0.0, False, 80400.0, 0.0, 15.0896, 14.9104
End Sub

Sub Step3()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.006)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius -0.035, -0.02, 0, 0.0045
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius -0.035, 0.02, 0, 0.0045
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.035, -0.02, 0, 0.0045
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.035, 0.02, 0, 0.0045
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Base holes", nm, True, True, 1, 0, 0.01, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 78873.186, 0.0, 15.3236, 15.1991
End Sub

Sub Step4()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(0, 0.04)
    sm.CreateArc 0.015, 0.04, 0, 0.015, 0.035, 0, 0.015, 0.045, 0, 1
    sm.CreateLine 0.015, 0.045, 0, -0.015, 0.045, 0
    sm.CreateArc -0.015, 0.04, 0, -0.015, 0.045, 0, -0.015, 0.035, 0, 1
    sm.CreateLine -0.015, 0.035, 0, 0.015, 0.035, 0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Wall slot", nm, True, True, 1, 0, 0.01, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 76601.9471, -0.0, 14.5919, 14.5527
End Sub

Sub Step5()
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickEdge -0.05, 0.003, -0.04
    PickEdge 0.05, 0.003, -0.04
    FinishFillet "Vertical corners", 0.006, 76509.2391, -0.0, 14.606, 14.6172
End Sub

Function FindPlanes() As Boolean
    Dim f As Object, n As Long
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And n < 3
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "RefPlane" Then
            Set Planes(n) = f
            n = n + 1
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    FindPlanes = (n = 3)
End Function

Function OffsetPlane(idx As Long, offM As Double) As Object
    If offM <= 0 Then
        Set OffsetPlane = Planes(idx)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
    Set OffsetPlane = fm.InsertRefPlane(8, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
End Function

Sub BeginSketch(pl As Object)
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    pl.Select2 False, 0
    sm.InsertSketch True
    sm.AddToDB = True
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = False
End Sub

Function EndSketch() As String
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    DefineSketch
    sm.InsertSketch True
    EndSketch = Part.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
End Function

Sub DefineSketch()
    ' Same as Tools > Dimensions > Fully Define Sketch, measured from the origin, so the
    ' sketch turns black with its sizes shown. If it fails the sketch is kept as drawn.
    ' Relations: coincident, horizontal, vertical, tangent, perpendicular, concentric.
    On Error Resume Next
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.Extension.SelectByID2 "Point1@Origin", "EXTSKETCHPOINT", 0, 0, 0, False, 6, Nothing, 0
    sm.FullyDefineSketch True, True, 606, True, 1, Nothing, 1, Nothing, 1, 1
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Function Matches(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Matches = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    Matches = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.0005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.0025)
End Function

Function PickSketch(nm As String) As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickSketch = Part.Extension.SelectByID2(nm, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
End Function

Sub Solid(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, d1 As Double, _
          dang As Double, t0 As Long, startM As Double, firstDir As Boolean, _
          expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, a As Long, b As Long, c As Long, dirFlag As Boolean, fs As Boolean, dOut As Boolean
    Dim useDraft As Boolean, nA As Long, nB As Long
    useDraft = (dang > 0)
    nA = 0: If t0 = 3 Then nA = 1
    nB = 0: If useDraft Then nB = 1
    For a = 0 To nA
        For b = 0 To nB
            For c = 0 To 1
                fs = (a = 1): dOut = (b = 1)
                dirFlag = firstDir: If c = 1 Then dirFlag = Not firstDir
                PickSketch nm
                Set f = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                If isCut Then
                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Function WizFlag(Optional ByVal v As Integer = -1) As Boolean
    ' Remembers whether the last hole was made by Hole Wizard, so its counterbore step is skipped.
    Static made As Boolean
    If v >= 0 Then made = (v = 1)
    WizFlag = made
End Function

Function MatchesLoose(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard uses standard drill and tap sizes and drill points, so allow a little more.
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    MatchesLoose = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    MatchesLoose = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.01) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.25)
End Function

Function HoleWiz(label As String, gtype As Long, fastener As Long, size As String, thru As Boolean, firstEnd As Long, _
                 dia As Double, depth As Double, vals As String, pts As String, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double, _
                 expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard, standard JIS (9). Each hole is picked on the face where it starts.
    ' Through holes try Up To Next (11), then Through All (1).
    Dim v As Variant, p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, tries As Long, endT As Long, f As Object
    Dim a(11) As Double
    HoleWiz = False
    v = Split(vals, ",")
    For k = 0 To 11
        a(k) = Val(v(k))
    Next k
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For tries = 0 To 1
        If thru Then
            endT = firstEnd
            If tries = 1 Then endT = IIf(firstEnd = 11, 1, 11)
            If gtype = 4 Then a(7) = IIf(endT = 1, 1, 2)
        Else
            If tries = 1 Then Exit Function
            endT = 0
        End If
        Part.ClearSelection2 True
        For k = 0 To UBound(p)
            q = Split(p(k), ",")
            Part.Extension.SelectByRay Val(q(0)) - dx * 0.0001, Val(q(1)) - dy * 0.0001, Val(q(2)) - dz * 0.0001, _
                dx, dy, dz, 0.0002, 2, True, 0, 0
        Next k
        Set f = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set f = fm.HoleWizard5(gtype, 9, fastener, size, endT, dia, depth, -1, a(0), a(1), a(2), a(3), a(4), a(5), _
            a(6), a(7), a(8), a(9), a(10), a(11), "", False, True, True, True, True, False)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If MatchesLoose(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                HoleWiz = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next tries
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Function

Sub PickEdge(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Pick by geometry so the result does not depend on the current view.
    Dim b As Variant, e As Variant, p As Variant, sd As Object, i As Long
    Dim dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    b = Part.GetBodies2(0, False)
    e = b(0).GetEdges
    Set sd = Part.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
    sd.Mark = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(e)
        p = e(i).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
        dx = p(0) - x: dy = p(1) - y: dz = p(2) - z
        If dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 0.000000000001 Then
            e(i).Select4 True, sd
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub FinishFillet(label As String, r As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim a0(0) As Double, v As Variant, f As Object
    a0(0) = 0
    v = a0
    Set f = fm.FeatureFillet3(195, r, r, 0, 0, 0, 0, v, v, v, v, v, v, v)
    Part.EditRebuild3
    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
        If Not f Is Nothing Then f.Name = label
    Else
        Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Sub FinishChamfer(label As String, d As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object
    Set f = fm.InsertFeatureChamfer(6, 1, d, 0.785398163397448, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    Part.EditRebuild3
    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
        If Not f Is Nothing Then f.Name = label
    Else
        Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

' Tools > Macro > Run, choose this .swb file (or paste it into a new macro).

Dim Part As Object
Dim fm As Object
Dim sm As Object
Dim Planes(2) As Object
Dim Problems As String

Sub main()
    Dim tpl As String, folder As String, target As String
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    tpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)
    If tpl = "" Then tpl = swApp.GetDocumentTemplate(1, "", 0, 0, 0)
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument(tpl, 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Cannot create a new part. Set the default part template in System Options."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set fm = Part.FeatureManager
    Set sm = Part.SketchManager
    If Not FindPlanes() Then
        MsgBox "Front, Top and Right planes were not found in the template."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Step1
    Step2
    Step3
    Step4
    Step5
    Step6
    Step7
    Step8
    Step9
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    folder = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder
    target = folder & "\Control_Box_Cover.SLDPRT"
    Part.SaveAs3 target, 0, 1
    If Problems = "" Then
        MsgBox "Done. All features match the STEP model." & vbCrLf & target
    Else
        MsgBox "Saved, but check these features:" & vbCrLf & Problems & vbCrLf & target

End Sub

Sub Step1()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.0)
    sm.CreateLine -0.08, -0.05, 0, 0.08, -0.05, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.08, -0.05, 0, 0.08, 0.05, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.08, 0.05, 0, -0.08, 0.05, 0
    sm.CreateLine -0.08, 0.05, 0, -0.08, -0.05, 0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Block", nm, False, True, 0, 0, 0.024, 0.0, 0, 0.0, False, 384000.0, -0.0, 12.0, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step2()
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickEdge -0.08, 0.012, 0.05
    PickEdge 0.08, 0.012, 0.05
    PickEdge 0.08, 0.012, -0.05
    PickEdge -0.08, 0.012, -0.05
    FinishFillet "Corner radius", 0.008, 382681.4863, 0.0, 12.0, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step3()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.0)
    sm.CreateLine -0.076, -0.046, 0, 0.076, -0.046, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.076, -0.046, 0, 0.076, 0.046, 0
    sm.CreateLine 0.076, 0.046, 0, -0.076, 0.046, 0
    sm.CreateLine -0.076, 0.046, 0, -0.076, -0.046, 0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Pocket", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.02, 0.0, 0, 0.0, False, 103001.4863, 0.0, 17.4306, -0.0
End Sub

Sub Step4()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(2, 0.08)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.0, 0.012, 0, 0.008
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Cable gland", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.005, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 102197.2386, -0.6138, 17.4733, -0.0
End Sub

Sub Step5()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.024)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius -0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.00225
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.00225
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Screw cbore", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.004, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 102070.0041, -0.6146, 17.4677, -0.0
End Sub

Sub Step6()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.024)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius -0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.004
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.05, 0.0, 0, 0.004
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Screw cbore counterbore", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.002, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 101932.5594, -0.6154, 17.4602, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step7()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.024)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.0, 0.03, 0, 0.00225
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.0, -0.03, 0, 0.00225
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Screw csk", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.004, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 101805.3249, -0.6162, 17.4546, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step8()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.024)
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.0, 0.03, 0, 0.0045
    sm.CreateCircleByRadius 0.0, -0.03, 0, 0.0045
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Screw csk countersink", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.00225, 0.785398163397, 0, 0.0, True, 101709.899, -0.6168, 17.4491, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step9()
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickEdge 0.0, 0.024, 0.05
    PickEdge 0.0, 0.024, -0.05
    FinishChamfer "Top edge", 0.001, 101457.8135, -0.6183, 17.4336, 0.0
End Sub

Function FindPlanes() As Boolean
    Dim f As Object, n As Long
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And n < 3
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "RefPlane" Then
            Set Planes(n) = f
            n = n + 1
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    FindPlanes = (n = 3)
End Function

Function OffsetPlane(idx As Long, offM As Double) As Object
    If offM <= 0 Then
        Set OffsetPlane = Planes(idx)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
    Set OffsetPlane = fm.InsertRefPlane(8, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
End Function

Sub BeginSketch(pl As Object)
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    pl.Select2 False, 0
    sm.InsertSketch True
    sm.AddToDB = True
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = False
End Sub

Function EndSketch() As String
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    DefineSketch
    sm.InsertSketch True
    EndSketch = Part.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
End Function

Sub DefineSketch()
    ' Same as Tools > Dimensions > Fully Define Sketch, measured from the origin, so the
    ' sketch turns black with its sizes shown. If it fails the sketch is kept as drawn.
    ' Relations: coincident, horizontal, vertical, tangent, perpendicular, concentric.
    On Error Resume Next
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.Extension.SelectByID2 "Point1@Origin", "EXTSKETCHPOINT", 0, 0, 0, False, 6, Nothing, 0
    sm.FullyDefineSketch True, True, 606, True, 1, Nothing, 1, Nothing, 1, 1
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Function Matches(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Matches = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    Matches = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.0005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.0025)
End Function

Function PickSketch(nm As String) As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickSketch = Part.Extension.SelectByID2(nm, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
End Function

Sub Solid(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, d1 As Double, _
          dang As Double, t0 As Long, startM As Double, firstDir As Boolean, _
          expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, a As Long, b As Long, c As Long, dirFlag As Boolean, fs As Boolean, dOut As Boolean
    Dim useDraft As Boolean, nA As Long, nB As Long
    useDraft = (dang > 0)
    nA = 0: If t0 = 3 Then nA = 1
    nB = 0: If useDraft Then nB = 1
    For a = 0 To nA
        For b = 0 To nB
            For c = 0 To 1
                fs = (a = 1): dOut = (b = 1)
                dirFlag = firstDir: If c = 1 Then dirFlag = Not firstDir
                PickSketch nm
                Set f = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                If isCut Then
                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c

                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Function WizFlag(Optional ByVal v As Integer = -1) As Boolean
    ' Remembers whether the last hole was made by Hole Wizard, so its counterbore step is skipped.
    Static made As Boolean
    If v >= 0 Then made = (v = 1)
    WizFlag = made
End Function

Function MatchesLoose(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard uses standard drill and tap sizes and drill points, so allow a little more.
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    MatchesLoose = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    MatchesLoose = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.01) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.25)
End Function

Function HoleWiz(label As String, gtype As Long, fastener As Long, size As String, thru As Boolean, firstEnd As Long, _
                 dia As Double, depth As Double, vals As String, pts As String, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double, _
                 expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard, standard JIS (9). Each hole is picked on the face where it starts.
    ' Through holes try Up To Next (11), then Through All (1).
    Dim v As Variant, p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, tries As Long, endT As Long, f As Object
    Dim a(11) As Double
    HoleWiz = False
    v = Split(vals, ",")
    For k = 0 To 11
        a(k) = Val(v(k))
    Next k
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For tries = 0 To 1
        If thru Then
            endT = firstEnd
            If tries = 1 Then endT = IIf(firstEnd = 11, 1, 11)
            If gtype = 4 Then a(7) = IIf(endT = 1, 1, 2)
        Else
            If tries = 1 Then Exit Function
            endT = 0
        End If
        Part.ClearSelection2 True
        For k = 0 To UBound(p)
            q = Split(p(k), ",")
            Part.Extension.SelectByRay Val(q(0)) - dx * 0.0001, Val(q(1)) - dy * 0.0001, Val(q(2)) - dz * 0.0001, _
                dx, dy, dz, 0.0002, 2, True, 0, 0
        Next k
        Set f = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set f = fm.HoleWizard5(gtype, 9, fastener, size, endT, dia, depth, -1, a(0), a(1), a(2), a(3), a(4), a(5), _
            a(6), a(7), a(8), a(9), a(10), a(11), "", False, True, True, True, True, False)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If MatchesLoose(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                HoleWiz = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next tries
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Function

Sub PickEdge(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Pick by geometry so the result does not depend on the current view.
    Dim b As Variant, e As Variant, p As Variant, sd As Object, i As Long
    Dim dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    b = Part.GetBodies2(0, False)
    e = b(0).GetEdges
    Set sd = Part.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
    sd.Mark = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(e)
        p = e(i).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
        dx = p(0) - x: dy = p(1) - y: dz = p(2) - z
        If dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 0.000000000001 Then
            e(i).Select4 True, sd
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub
